2026-11-29-sglearning-short.title: Sona aur chandi ke rate achanak kyun gire?
2026-11-29-sglearning-short.summary: The Short of the 28 Nov long on the same subject (founder, 28 Nov 2026: 'on same topic you make short of that sona chandi ke rates kyun gire'). One clear answer in under a minute: how far gold and silver fell and in how many days (check peak and current prices against LBMA, MCX, COMEX), the two or three causes that mattered most (the dollar and interest-rate expectations, profit-booking after the rally, exchange margin changes), why silver fell further, and the one mistake buyers make. Explanation only, no advice to buy or sell. Point to the long video for the full study.
hooks: Sona kitne din mein kitna gira, aur kisne becha?
Chandi sone se zyada kyun giri?

2026-12-02-sglearning-long.title: Esports ka paisa kahan se aata hai? Prize pool, sponsor aur khiladi ki kamai
2026-12-02-sglearning-long.summary: Where the money in esports comes from, with the PMGC and Free Fire world finals as the examples: how a prize pool is built (publisher funding, sponsors, ticket and viewer revenue), how a prize is split between team, players and organisers, what a pro player earns beyond the prize, and what happens to the teams that do not win. Check: the reported prize pools of PMGC 2026 and FFWS Global Finals, and how Indian tournaments pay tax on winnings. Explanation only; no advice to invest or play for money.
hooks: Prize pool kaun deta hai, aur kyun?
Jeetne wale ko kitna milta hai, haarne wale ko kitna?
Khiladi ki asli kamai kahan se aati hai?
